audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Sett Levels 1, 2 and 3 and put First item at Skill, while the whys text directly beneath said 'Level 1 is Darius's', 'Level 2 stays Darius', 'Level 3 Darius still leads' and 'First item swings back to Darius'.
audit.why: The packet chart and the already-audited mirror agree on Darius / Darius / Darius / Skill / Sett / Darius / Skill. The mirror flipped exactly those four rows on its side; leaving mine unflipped would have rendered opposite answers on the two pages.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 flipped to Darius as one atomic paired group across both layers, ratings brought down to match, and the four phases[N].why lines rewritten so they argue for the side now shown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Apprehend (Pull)' is not an ability name, and it was the tracked cooldown in the TL;DR, win condition, loading screen, focus panel, cooldown panel, three phases, both do's and five report sections — with no number attached anywhere. The cooldown panel listed it twice, once invented and once real.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s. At rank 1 that is a twenty-six second hole — the longest punish window either champion has, and the single most actionable number in the matchup. Decimate is 9s, Crippling Strike a flat 5s, Noxian Guillotine 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: The invented name removed everywhere and replaced with Apprehend at its real 26s, stated as the length of the window it opens rather than as a vague 'bait his pull'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seven strings told the reader that The Show Stopper suppresses Darius and cancels or denies Noxian Guillotine — it was the stated reason Level 6 flips and the stated reason the late game is survivable. Absent: Decimate's outer blade being both the damage and the heal, and Crippling Strike being an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's text for The Show Stopper is carry, slam, damage and a landing slow. It contains no suppression and nothing that interrupts a cast, and the mirror audit reached the same conclusion. Building a level-6 win condition on it is exactly the failure mode that costs trust. The real level-6 case is simpler and true: the carry pulls him off his own wave and the Haymaker centre is true damage.
audit.corrected: Suppression and Guillotine-denial removed from whys[4], spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late and wants.you[1], replaced with what the ability actually does. Decimate's blade-versus-handle split written into dontsFull[1].d and the cooldown panel; the five-stack enrage and Guillotine's stack scaling into dontsFull[0].d; the Crippling Strike reset into phases[1].why.

notes: This entry's level-6 win condition was a fabrication: seven separate strings told the reader The Show Stopper suppresses Darius and cancels Noxian Guillotine, and the whole late-game plan ('R held to cancel his execute') was built on it. Riot's text gives Sett's R a carry, a slam, damage and a landing slow — nothing that interrupts a cast. I rebuilt Level 6 on what is true instead. The page also tracked an invented 'Apprehend (Pull)' with no cooldown, hiding the best fact in the matchup: Apprehend is 26 seconds at rank 1.
